pages.title: Light from Moss
pages.text: Turn a found mineral into working light through its processing route.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the native material and effective lamp recipe. Heart Goo separately comes from a Sculk Heart; it is not a random drop from every infected block.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Fluorite is processed at a grindstone for lamps; Heart Goo has the separate Sculk Heart source.
